My AI policy

If a project doesn't have an AI_POLICY.md, this is my personal policy:

  • All AI assisted commits will have an Assisted-by: <Harness>:<model> trailer.
  • All AI generated text in descriptions, comments, etc. will be marked by 🤖 _AI text below_ 🤖 or otherwise clearly indicated (detail block, etc)
  • Mechanical changes that don't make a commit (like a rebase) might not have a marker since there's no place to put one.

I oversee all changes directly (I don't use unattended harnesses) and usually hand edit at least a little.

Regen Engineering

Regen Engineering is an open methodology I'm developing for owning software as knowledge.

Knowledge is the asset. Code is the byproduct.

The system knowledge is the versioned, governed source. Implementations are verified build artifacts that any capable AI can regenerate, at the smallest scope, on any stack. The manifesto is at v0.3 (draft).

Repo What it is
📜 regen.engineering The manifesto and site
🗃️ regen-engineering-schema Knowledge schema and reference validator: Markdown plus YAML frontmatter, validated as a graph
🧰 regen-engineering-skills Reference implementation as agent skills
♻️ regen-engineering-demo Two implementations, one contract suite, same knowledge: delete an implementation and regenerate it
💾 regen-engineering-stateful Reference system for REP-0005: what the method says about systems that own data

Writing about it:

  • I deleted my source code and regenerated it in a different language
  • An agent documented my app, found 4 bugs I did not know about, then rebuilt it from the docs
  • My tests passed 18 out of 18. The service deletes your database on startup

Placeforge: AI-Built Roblox Games

I'm building Placeforge, an AI agent that plans, builds, tests, and publishes Roblox games inside Roblox Studio.

It composes from a library of 136 hand-crafted, headless-tested Luau kits across 17 families, verifies its own builds with a playtest-and-repair loop, and deploys through the Roblox Open Cloud API. The proof is live: these games were built by the agent, end to end.

Game What the agent shipped
🐾 Paws and Bubbles Daycare Pet daycare: adoption, care stations, boutique, Best in Show contest, persistent saves, server-validated monetization
🏝️ Treasure Cove Hidden-object hunt: a 700x700 island hiding 45 tiered treasures across a port village, shipwreck, and temple

Every game has daily rewards, rotating daily quests, and atomic DataStore persistence, all composed from the same kit library. A third game (an Australian outback tycoon) is next.
